        @AIIgnore, @AIPrivacy, @AICore, @AIPerformance). Zero third-party dependencies.
        All annotations use RetentionPolicy.SOURCE so they leave no trace in the
        consumer's compiled bytecode — this jar exists purely to give javac the
        symbols it needs at compile time.

        Pair this with vibetags-processor on the annotation-processor classpath:

            <dependency>
                <groupId>se.deversity.vibetags</groupId>

items.title:
org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-data-store-java 14.62.0 发布, Runtime that reflects over client Java classes annotated with Dirigible's @Entity (declared
        in engine-java) and registers them with a Hibernate SessionFactory rooted at the default

        can depend on this small leaf module instead of the full engine — that in turn lets
        components/api/api-modules-java publish the org.eclipse.dirigible.sdk.* annotations to
        engine-java without forming a cycle through api-bpm.

    Gargantua turns Java methods (@AgentTool) and Markdown files (SKILL.md) into a deployable
    agent service with skills, hybrid routing, 3-layer memory, guardrails, human-in-the-loop
    approvals, multi-provider LLM failover, RAG with a pluggable EmbeddingPort, A2A protocol,
    MCP server gateway, cost tracking and an immutable audit trail. Ships an embedded
    zero-infra mode for tests and demos.
items.summary:
